note.zh: 引文核查记录。逐条核对 soma 里“凭记忆”“未打开”“未核实”或没有出处的已发表事实：claim 是仓库里的说法，usedIn 是它被用到的文件和键，opened 写明这次实际打开并读到了什么（出版社全文、PMC 全文、仅摘要、某个 PDF 里的表、仓库里的数据文件，或“无法打开”），supportedValue 只记录在已打开的文字里读到的数值。verdict：verified = 打开的出处支持现用的值；corrected = 出处给出不同的值或不同的定义；unsupported = 打开的出处不支持，或属于没有出处的建模选择；could-not-open = 能定论的出处没能读到；not-audited = 只登记、这次没有核对。本文件只是记录，不改动任何代码或数据；采纳建议时请改相应文件并在那里引用这里的条目 id。数值都来自 2026-10-12 这一次会话里实际打开的文本；经 Internet Archive 读到的全文已在 opened 里注明。没有复制任何受版权保护的表格全文，只摘录事实性数值。未经专业人员审阅。
note.en: A citation audit. It checks, one by one, published facts in soma that were marked 'from memory', 'not opened', 'unverified' or carried no source: `claim` is the statement in the repository, `usedIn` the files and keys that use it, `opened` exactly what was opened and read this time (publisher full text, PMC full text, abstract only, a table in a named PDF, a dataset file in this repository, or 'could not open'), and `supportedValue` holds only numbers read in the opened text. Verdicts: verified = the opened source supports the value as used; corrected = the source gives a different value or definition; unsupported = the sources opened do not support it, or it is a modelling choice with no source; could-not-open = a source that would settle it could not be read; not-audited = listed only, not checked this time. This file is a record and changes no code or data; when adopting a recommendation, edit the file concerned and cite the entry id from here. All numbers come from text actually opened in the session of 2026-10-12; full texts read through the Internet Archive are identified as such under `opened`. No copyrighted table is reproduced in full, only factual values. Not reviewed by a specialist.

entries.opened: Publisher full text read from Internet Archive copies (the live publisher site returned HTTP 403): HTML snapshot of 2010-02-09 of jap.physiology.org/cgi/content/full/89/1/81 (Methods 'SM Measurement by MRI', Results, Fig. 1 legend, Discussion) and PDF snapshot of 2017-11-06 of jap.physiology.org/content/jap/89/1/81.full.pdf (Table 1).
entries.supportedValue: Table 1 (means ± SD). All women (n = 200): total SM 21.0 ± 3.8 kg, lower body 12.2 ± 2.5 kg, upper body 8.4 ± 1.8 kg. All men (n = 268): total 33.0 ± 5.3 kg, lower body 18.1 ± 3.1 kg, upper body 14.1 ± 2.6 kg. Ratios F/M: upper 8.4/14.1 = 0.596, lower 12.2/18.1 = 0.674, total 0.636. Age 18-29 only (40 women, 66 men): upper 8.7/14.3 = 0.608, lower 12.5/18.5 = 0.676, total 21.8/33.7 = 0.647. Discussion: 'women ... had 40% less muscle than men in the upper body, in the lower body gender differences in muscle mass were only 33%'. Division (Methods): transverse MRI images every 40 mm with the L4-L5 intervertebral space as origin, subject prone with arms straight overhead; 'Lower body SM mass was calculated using the images extending from one image below L4-L5 to the foot, whereas upper body SM mass was calculated using the images extending from L4-L5 to the hand'. Fig. 1 legend: upper + lower do not sum to 100 % because a 4-cm gap separates them.

notes.zh: 两个比值与表 1 一致（0.596、0.674，四舍五入为 0.60、0.67）；只看 18–29 岁组也几乎相同（0.61、0.68）。论文的分界是 L4–L5 椎间隙所在的那一张横断面：这一张及以上（含上肢、头颈）算上半身，往下 40 mm 的那一张及以下算下半身。管线用髂嵴最高点：按通常的解剖学说法，两侧髂嵴最高点的连线约在 L4 棘突或 L4–L5 椎间隙水平（这一条本次没有另开出处核对），所以两种分法相差不超过约一个椎体的高度，可以认为相符；female.ts 里“assumed; not taken from the paper”的说明可以改为“论文用 L4–L5 椎间隙，与髂嵴最高点大致同高”。两点差别要知道：论文是按 MRI 断层分，管线是按每块肌肉的质心分，跨过分界的肌肉（腰大肌、竖脊肌、腹壁肌）归属会不同；论文样本 18–88 岁、BMI 16–48，67 % 为白人，亚洲人只占 8 %。
notes.en: Both ratios agree with Table 1 (0.596 and 0.674, rounded to 0.60 and 0.67); the 18-29 group alone gives nearly the same (0.61, 0.68). The paper divides at the transverse image through the L4-L5 intervertebral space: that image and everything above it (arms, head and neck included) is upper body, the image 40 mm below and everything under it is lower body. The pipeline uses the top of the iliac crest: by the usual anatomical statement the line joining the tops of the iliac crests crosses the L4 spinous process or the L4-L5 interspace (no source was opened for that statement in this session), so the two divisions differ by no more than about one vertebral height and can be taken to match; the note 'assumed; not taken from the paper' in female.ts can become 'the paper uses the L4-L5 interspace, about level with the top of the iliac crest'. Two differences to keep in mind: the paper splits by MRI slice whereas the pipeline assigns each whole muscle by its centroid, so muscles that cross the level (psoas, erector spinae, abdominal wall) are attributed differently; and the sample is aged 18-88 with BMI 16-48, 67 % Caucasian and only 8 % Asian.

notes.zh: 2 mm 落在已打开文献的范围内：年轻成人静止露齿约 2–3.4 mm，女性比男性多 0.3–1.5 mm，随年龄减少，60 岁以上约为 0。对 20–24 岁的女性参考体，2.5–3 mm 更接近年轻女性的数值（沙特 19–25 岁组 2.93 mm；Vig 与 Brundo 女性 3.40 mm 是转引），男性 2 mm 合适；差别只有 0.5–1 mm，不必改，但可以把注释里的“没有核对文献”换成这些出处。注意量法：文献量的是“唇放松、略分开”时上唇下缘到切缘的距离；我们的皮肤是闭口的，口裂线就是上唇下缘，两者可以对应。没有找到可用的中国年轻人卡尺测量数据；云南汉族的视频测量值（0.30 mm）与其他研究差得太远，不采用。Vig 与 Brundo 1978 原文没有打开，按年龄分组的数值只在搜索摘要里见过，没有记入。
notes.en: 2 mm is inside the range of the sources opened: young adults show about 2-3.4 mm at rest, women 0.3-1.5 mm more than men, falling with age to about 0 above 60. For the reference woman aged 20-24, 2.5-3 mm would be closer to the values for young women (2.93 mm in the Saudi 19-25 group; the 3.40 mm for women in Vig & Brundo is second-hand) and 2 mm suits the man; the difference is only 0.5-1 mm, so nothing needs changing, but the comment 'not checked against a source' can now cite these. Note the method: the literature measures from the lower border of the relaxed, slightly parted upper lip to the incisal edge; our skin has closed lips, whose fissure line is that lower border, so the two correspond. No usable caliper data for young Chinese adults were found; the video-based Yunnan Han figure (0.30 mm) is too far from every other study to adopt. Vig & Brundo 1978 itself was not opened, and its per-age values were seen only in a search-engine snippet and are not recorded here.

notes.en: As a rounded approximation 0.13 / 0.12 m holds: 65 / 60 mm per SD lies between the populations already in the repository — ANSUR II gives 68.6 / 64.2 mm (2 SD = 0.137 / 0.128 m), the GB/T 10000-1988 percentiles imply 58.3 / 53.2 mm (2 SD = 0.117 / 0.106 m), and NHANES adults unweighted give 78.3 / 71.9 mm (ethnic groups and ages pooled, hence larger). The note's 'adult stature SD is about 6-7 cm' is right for the US Army sample and on the high side for Chinese adults: the Chinese data opened give 5.8-6.6 cm for men and 5.3-5.8 cm for women. If '±2 SD' is meant for the Chinese reference population, use about 0.117 m for men and 0.106 m for women (GB/T 10000-1988, 1986-87 survey, reprinted table read by eye, normal approximation), about 10 % less than the present values; that is a change of reference population rather than an error, so correctedValue is left null. The NHANES figures were computed in this session from the raw files in the repository: unweighted, and P_BMX overlaps BMX_J, so they are indicative only.

notes.zh: 论文的数值与仓库里写的完全一致。它的人群与参考体的身高、BMI 很接近（162.1 cm / 21.8 对 160.6 cm / 21.6），只是族裔不同。中国年轻女性的同类数据只找到转引值：Al-Qattan 的表 4 引 Qiao 等 1997，中国女性胸骨上切迹到乳头 19.05 cm，比 19.8 cm 短 0.75 cm（约 4 %），在其 1 个标准差（2.5 cm）之内；Qiao 1997 的原文没有打开。乳头间距没有找到中国年轻女性的数值：上海 605 名乳腺疾病患者（平均 48.8 岁）乳头到中线 10.0 ± 1.5 cm，相当于间距约 20.0 cm，与 20.3 cm 只差 0.3 cm；同一组的切迹到乳头是 21.6 cm，反映的是年龄和哺乳后的下垂，不适用于 20–24 岁。结论：间距不用改；切迹到乳头若要贴近中国年轻女性，可降到约 19.0–19.5 cm，但依据是转引，证据不强。
notes.en: The paper's values are exactly those in the repository. Its sample is close to the reference body in height and BMI (162.1 cm / 21.8 against 160.6 cm / 21.6) and differs only in ancestry. For young Chinese women only a second-hand figure was found: Table 4 of Al-Qattan cites Qiao et al. 1997 for a notch-to-nipple distance of 19.05 cm in Chinese women, 0.75 cm (about 4 %) shorter than 19.8 cm and well inside one SD (2.5 cm); Qiao 1997 itself was not opened. No internipple distance for young Chinese women was found: in 605 Shanghai patients with breast disease (mean age 48.8) the nipple lay 10.0 ± 1.5 cm from the midline, i.e. about 20.0 cm between nipples, 0.3 cm from 20.3 cm; the same group's notch-to-nipple distance of 21.6 cm reflects age and post-lactation ptosis and does not apply at 20-24. Conclusion: leave the internipple distance; the notch-to-nipple distance could be lowered to about 19.0-19.5 cm to sit nearer young Chinese women, but the basis is second-hand and weak.

notes.en: 370 mL agrees with Table 1 of the paper (right 367, left 378, mean 372.5 mL). fat-literature.json describes these as age-adjusted means ± SE in Australian women scanned prone in 3D; that description was not re-read here, only the numbers were checked. Against Chinese women: the abstract of Qiao et al. 1997 gives a mean of 325.36 ± 12.66 mL in 125 young Chinese women (abstract only; the meaning of ± is not stated), about 12 % below 370 mL; 605 Shanghai patients (mean age 48.8, BMI 22.9) have a formula-estimated 340 ± 109 mL, about 8 % below. Both indicate that the Australian figure is some 30-45 mL high. For the Chinese reference woman aged 20-24 with BMI 21.6, about 325 mL would fit better; but Qiao's method differs from 3D scanning and the paper was not opened, so this is offered as a suggestion, not as a correction.

claim.en: PSPI = AU4 + max(AU6, AU7) + max(AU9, AU10) + AU43; each AU 0-5 and AU43 0 or 1, 16 levels. The original (Prkachin & Solomon 2008) was not opened; the formula is second-hand from chen2018 and egede2017.

notes.zh: 仓库里用到的事实全部成立，而且现在有了第一手出处。82.71 % 与表 II 一致（40029 / 48398）；论文正文写的 83.6 % 与它自己的表不符，应以表为准，仓库现值不用改。逐 AU 的统计（表 I）现在已取得，可以写进 sources.json：最常见的是 AU12（6887 帧）、AU6（5557）、AU7（3366）、AU43（2434）、AU25（2407）、AU26（2093），而 AU4 只有 1074 帧、AU9 423、AU10 525，AU27 在表里没有一行。这对映射有意义：在这个库里，眼眶收紧和闭眼远比降眉、皱鼻、提上唇常见；PSPI ≥ 5 的帧只占 1.85 %（895 帧），≥ 3 占 6.4 %。库是 25 人的子集，原研究录了 129 人。
notes.en: Every fact used in the repository holds and now has a first-hand source. 82.71 % agrees with Table II (40029 / 48398); the 83.6 % in the paper's running text contradicts its own table, the table should be followed, and the repository's value needs no change. The per-AU statistics (Table I) are now available and can go into sources.json: the most frequent are AU12 (6887 frames), AU6 (5557), AU7 (3366), AU43 (2434), AU25 (2407) and AU26 (2093), whereas AU4 has only 1074 frames, AU9 423 and AU10 525, and AU27 has no row in the table. This matters for the mapping: in this archive orbit tightening and eye closure are far more common than brow lowering, nose wrinkling or upper-lip raising; frames with PSPI >= 5 are only 1.85 % (895 frames) and >= 3 are 6.4 %. The archive is a 25-subject subset; 129 participants were recorded in the original study.

Anatomically procerus draws the medial end of the brow down, so giving it a weight is a reasonable modelling choice, but a weight of 1 equal to corrugator has no source; aus.json should label it as an assumption rather than as the muscular basis.

claim.zh: 参数化肌肉的两类想法出自 Waters 1987：线状肌在影响区内把皮肤拉向固定端并随距离衰减；环状肌（括约肌）。论文未打开，只核对了题录。
claim.en: The idea of two kinds of parametric muscle comes from Waters 1987: a linear muscle pulling the skin in a zone of influence towards its fixed end with a falloff, and a sphincter. The paper was not opened; only the bibliographic record was checked.

entries.source: Waters K. A muscle model for animating three-dimensional facial expression. Computer Graphics (Proc. SIGGRAPH '87) 1987;21(4):17-24.
entries.opened: Publisher PDF (ACM Digital Library, bronze open access) read from the Internet Archive snapshot of 2024-08-30 of dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/37402.37405; 8 pages, text extracted from the scanned PDF (OCR quality, some garbled characters). The live ACM link returned HTTP 403.
entries.supportedValue: Title page: 'A Muscle Model for Animating Three-Dimensional Facial Expression', Keith Waters, Computer Graphics, Volume 21, Number 4, July 1987. 'two broad types of muscles are considered: linear/parallel muscles that pull and sphincter muscles that squeeze' (sheet muscle appears only in the anatomical overview). Linear muscle: 'The direction is towards the point of attachment, and the magnitude that is zero at the point of attachment and increases to maximum at the other point of insertion into the skin'; 'the zone of influence in the simplest form can be viewed as circular, and the fall-off is along the radius'; a cosine interpolant, optionally raised to a power, gives the falloff, with parameters for the falloff start and finish radii and the angular zone of influence (e.g. 'Zone of influence 35.0, fallstart 7.0, fallfin 14.0'). Sphincter: 'can be described from a single point around which the surface contracts as if drawn together like a s[tr]ing bag' (the OCR text reads 'sizing bag'). Muscle actions are validated against FACS action units.

notes.zh: sources.json 归给它的两点（线状肌向骨性附着端拉、影响区内衰减；括约肌向一点收拢）论文里都有，可以把“没有打开”改为已读。论文在解剖概述里还提到“片状肌”（颞部、颈阔肌），但模型只有这两类。DOI 有两种写法：Crossref / Semantic Scholar 记为 10.1145/37401.37405（题名印成 “animation”），ACM 的 PDF 路径是 10.1145/37402.37405；论文首页的题名是 “Animating”。
notes.en: Both points sources.json attributes to it (a linear muscle pulling towards its bony attachment with a falloff inside a zone of influence; a sphincter drawing the surface towards a point) are in the paper, so 'not opened' can become 'read'. The paper's anatomical overview also mentions sheet muscle (temporal region, platysma), but its model has only these two types. The DOI appears in two forms: Crossref / Semantic Scholar give 10.1145/37401.37405 (with the title printed as 'animation'), the ACM PDF path is 10.1145/37402.37405; the title on the paper's first page reads 'Animating'.

notes.en: The repository's three statements about the corpus (four intensity levels, female non-professional actors, 0.4-2 s) are sourced, but the source is the 2021 companion paper describing the core set (10 speakers); the abstract of the corpus paper says the full set has eleven speakers, and the sex of the eleventh is not stated in the text read here. The repository analyses the 185 pain vocalisations of the full set, a number that comes from the data files themselves and cannot be checked from the abstract. The body of the corpus paper (acoustic tables, intensity ratings) remains unread. The main caveat stands: these are vocalisations acted on instruction.

claim.zh: 出声的概率随疼痛强度上升：突发性刺激在强度 1 以下不出声、3 时一半、5 以上总是出声；持续性疼痛 2 以下不出声、5 时一半、8 以上总是出声。
claim.en: The probability of vocalising rises with pain intensity: for a sudden stimulus never below 1, half the time at 3, always from 5; for sustained pain never below 2, half the time at 5, always from 8.

entries.opened: Europe PMC full text PMC7587015 (Helmer LML, Weijenberg RAF, de Vries R, et al. Crying out in pain - A systematic review into the validity of vocalization as an indicator for pain. Eur J Pain 2020): abstract, Results sections 3.x, Discussion; searched for 'intensity', 'severity', 'proportion'.
entries.supportedValue: Helmer 2020: 35 studies included; 'An association between vocalization and pain was found in most studies, particularly when different types of vocalizations were included'; 'Moaning and pain are associated in most studies. For verbalization or screaming an association with pain is found in just under half of the cases, whereas sighing or groaning and pain are not associated in most cases'; conclusion: vocalization as a stand-alone indicator 'indicates only a limited aspect'. The review gives no proportion of people vocalising as a function of pain intensity and no threshold.

additionalSources.reference: Raine J, Pisanski K, Simner J, Reby D. Vocal communication of simulated pain. Bioacoustics 2019;28(5):404-426.
additionalSources.opened: not re-opened in this session (the repository records that the accepted manuscript was read)
additionalSources.finding: Per the repository it reports how acoustic features change across three acted pain levels, not whether a sound is produced; it cannot support a probability.

notes.zh: 这是建模选择，没有出处，代码里也是这样写的。Helmer 等 2020 只支持“疼痛与发声在多数研究中相关”，而且指出相关的强弱因发声类型而异（呻吟最稳定，叹气、哼声多数研究不相关）；没有任何按强度给出的出声比例。曲线的形状（阈值 1 / 2，半数点 3 / 5，饱和点 5 / 8）以及“持续性疼痛更常被忍住”都应继续标为假设。本次没有系统检索实验性疼痛研究里的发声发生率，所以不能说这样的数据不存在。
notes.en: This is a modelling choice without a source, as the code already says. Helmer et al. 2020 supports only that pain and vocalisation are associated in most studies, and adds that the strength of the association depends on the type of sound (moaning most consistently; sighing and groaning not associated in most studies); it gives no proportion vocalising by intensity. The shape of the curves (thresholds 1 / 2, half points 3 / 5, saturation 5 / 8) and the statement that sustained pain is more often borne silently should stay labelled as assumptions. No systematic search for vocalisation rates in experimental pain studies was made here, so it cannot be said that no such data exist.
